description.zh: 声码持续时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～30。
description.en: The duration of the sound code, in seconds. Valid values range from 1 to 30.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>  

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 声码名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一。
description.en: The name of the sound code. It must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance.

description.zh:
排程开放类型。

- 内部（默认）：取值为**INNER**，只允许排程所在实例下的设备请求声码解码。

- 公开：取值为**OPEN**，可以发送邮件的方式配置白名单，允许跨实例的设备请求声码解码，跨实例解码的用量计算在声码所在的实例下。
description.en:
The scheduling openness type.  

- Internal (default): Set to **INNER**. Only devices under the same instance as the schedule can request sound code decoding.  

- Public: Set to **OPEN**. You can configure a whitelist via email to allow devices from other instances to request sound code decoding. Usage for cross-instance decoding is counted toward the instance where the sound code resides.

description.zh: 声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等，长度限制100个字符。
description.en: The marketing content of the sound code, such as a product detail URL. The content can be up to 100 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为2。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 2.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-sound-code --duration 2 --sound-code-content www.taobao.com --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --name TEST123 --open-type OPEN --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateSoundCode --region cn-hangzhou --OpenType OPEN --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Duration 2 --SoundCodeContent 'www.taobao.com' --Name TEST123
